This version searches by county, which is how local coverage is
actually titled, and refuses any video that carries no local signal.
Counties come from the news crawler, which pulls them out of
headlines. Set url to null to use only the hand-written list below.
Counties are rotated across runs so the search budget is not blown
on the same ones every week.

_scoring_comment: A video must clear two separate tests, not one combined score.
1. Subject. A topic phrase has to appear in the title or description.
2. Local signal. It has to be tied to somewhere in the United States:
a named county, a named US state, broadcast call letters in the
channel name (KFOR, WJCL, KOCO), or a channel that is plainly a
The first version scored these together and set the bar at 3, which a
title match alone reached. That is what let the global explainer
channels through. Points now only order the results; the two tests
_limits_comment: search.list bills to its own bucket of roughly 100 calls a day, so

per page of 100 from the 10,000-unit pool and is effectively free.
